verdict.rationale: Cognee's own docs say the open-source engine and all pipelines run locally with no account, via an in-process Python call or local Docker. They also say the CLI demo works with no API key, no embedding provider and no network access. But nothing documents configuring local LLMs or embedding models for real, non-demo workloads, so the 'against local models without any cloud dependency' part is only shown for the demo. Missing for 10: documented local LLM/embedding provider configuration for production use, explicit confirmation that no cloud model calls are needed outside the demo, independent hands-on corroboration of fully offline operation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run the memory layer fully locally — embedded in-process or against local models — without any cloud dependency

citations.quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.
you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`.
`cognee-cli demo` gives you a working example with **no API key and no embedding provider**, on a machine with no network access
Run Cognee locally using Docker for development, testing, and custom deployments.
